high_level_description: The image depicts a small bathroom corner with a white toilet positioned against a tiled wall. The tiles are light beige with a subtle pattern that gives them a textured appearance. The floor is also covered with similar tiles, maintaining the same color scheme. To the left of the toilet, there is a handheld showerhead attached to a hose, which is coiled and resting on the floor. A green loofah or bath sponge is placed near the base of the showerhead, adding a pop of color to the otherwise neutral tones of the room.
